record.interface_detail: the Vibe CLI (`vibe`), the VS Code extension, ACP clients such as JetBrains IDEs, and Vibe Code Web on GitHub repositories in a cloud sandbox. Headless: `vibe --prompt` (`-p`) runs one task and exits, with `--auto-approve`, `--max-turns`, `--max-tokens`, `--time-limit` and `--output text|json|streaming`; only the CLI has a non-interactive mode
record.tooling: Vibe CLI, Apache-2.0, installed with `uv tool install mistral-vibe` or the install script; sign-in by browser or a key from Code > Vibe CLI in the MISTRAL_API_KEY variable; config presets also point the same CLI at other OpenAI-compatible providers
record.chaining: the plan budget is the same pool that Free mode API keys draw on (inference/mistral-la-plateforme), so CLI use and API use on one Organization spend one allowance; Pro and Team continue past the budget at API rates only when prepaid pay-as-you-go is enabled

limits.value: a monthly included usage shared across Studio, the API and Vibe Code; with pay-as-you-go off, the default, Vibe Code can stop until the next billing period. The size of the allowance is not published for any plan
Vibe Code Web: 2 sessions per day for Free users where access is enabled, 100 sessions per day for paid users; maximum session duration 24 hours, inactivity timeout 3 hours

record.binding_note: the monthly plan budget is what stops the CLI, and its size is unpublished; the per-day session cap applies to Vibe Code Web only

identity_cost.detail: a Mistral account with a verified phone number, and no card. Help centre copies archived on 2026-05-18 and 2026-08-05 state that the free API plan needs 'a verified phone number (one phone number per plan)' and that one phone number cannot be used across multiple free subscriptions, such as Vibe's free plan. The help centre article's copy archived on 2026-08-24 under its current slug has no phone section and the live article still has none, so the section was removed between 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-24; the live docs state only 'no credit card required', so whether the phone step still applies today is unverified: behind a sign-up. No country restriction is stated; a third-party guide reports a Taiwan number receiving the code. Pro is a paid subscription

record.reliability_note: paid-plan users report the CLI failing with 'Rate limit exceeded for mistral (model: mistral-vibe-cli-latest)' during ordinary use (GitHub issue mistralai/mistral-vibe#740, opened 2026-06-03); one commenter reports reaching the monthly limit after 4 days
record.confidence_note: plans, the headless flags, the shared budget and the Web session caps are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-10-30. The Free and Pro budget sizes are shown only after sign-in, so no token capacity is stated; a measured CLI run on a Free account would move the quota to measured.
